insights.headline: Meta goes all-in on Muse, its personal AI agent, at Connect 2026
insights.label: Meta Connect
key_facts: Muse is the centerpiece: real-time voice mode that keeps working on background tasks, with custom voices designed by description.
Muse comes to AI glasses (hands-free by name) and can act on what the wearer is looking at.
Muse for Mac gets computer use: it can operate any Mac app while the user is away.
New shopping and payment connectors: Walmart, Best Buy, Sephora, Ulta, Wayfair, Instacart, Shop Pay, PayPal; Expedia coming soon.
Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3: slimmer, action button, longest battery life of any Ray-Ban Meta.
Meta VR Glasses: about 100 grams (5x lighter than Quest 3), 5K micro-OLED, eye and hand tracking, $1,299.99, spring 2027.
FDA-cleared hearing assistance on AI glasses, $149.99, US later in 2026.
insights.why_it_matters: Meta is betting that the next computer is an AI agent you talk to and wear, not an app you open.
uncertainties: Muse Charm details come later in 2026.
VR Glasses and Hologram features don't ship until spring 2027.

beats.headline: Muse takes center stage
beats.narration: At Connect 2026, Meta put one thing at the center of everything: Muse, its personal AI agent.
beats.visual_prompt: A vast dark keynote stage, a single glowing orb of soft blue light hovering above it, silhouetted audience in the foreground, slow cinematic push-in, volumetric light, vertical framing. No text, no logos.

beats.headline: Real-time voice
beats.narration: Muse now talks back in real time, and keeps working on your tasks in the background.
beats.visual_prompt: Close-up of a smartphone lying on a wooden cafe table, a soft animated voice waveform glowing on its screen, warm morning light, shallow depth of field, gentle camera drift. No readable text, no logos.

beats.headline: Muse on your glasses
beats.narration: On AI glasses, just say its name, and it can act on whatever you're looking at.
beats.visual_prompt: First-person view through stylish smart glasses walking down a sunny city street, a subtle translucent highlight appearing around a storefront, natural motion, bright daylight. No readable text, no logos.

beats.headline: It runs your Mac
beats.narration: On a Mac, Muse can now operate any app, even while you're away from your desk.
beats.visual_prompt: An empty modern desk at dusk, a laptop screen glowing with windows opening and arranging themselves on their own, an empty chair pushed back, slow dolly-in, calm mood. No readable text, no logos.

beats.headline: Shopping, handled
beats.narration: It can shop and pay for you, with Walmart, Best Buy, Sephora, Shop Pay and PayPal on board.
beats.visual_prompt: Colorful shopping bags and a payment card floating and slowly rotating in a soft pastel studio, gentle bounce, playful product-commercial lighting. No text, no logos, no brand names.

beats.headline: Lighter, smarter glasses
beats.narration: New Ray-Ban Meta glasses are slimmer, add an action button, and get the longest battery yet.
beats.visual_prompt: A pair of sleek black smart glasses resting on a reflective surface, slow orbiting camera, crisp studio light, premium product shot. No text, no logos.

beats.headline: VR, five times lighter
beats.narration: Meta's new VR Glasses weigh about 100 grams, five times lighter than Quest 3, for $1,299.
beats.visual_prompt: A person seen from behind on a sofa wearing lightweight goggles, several floating translucent virtual screens arranged around a cozy living room, soft evening light, slow push-in. No readable text, no logos.

beats.headline: Why it matters
beats.narration: Why it matters: Meta is betting your next computer is an AI agent you talk to and wear.
beats.visual_prompt: Silhouette of a person wearing glasses on a rooftop at sunrise looking over a city skyline, warm golden light, slow cinematic pull-back, hopeful mood. No text, no logos.
